title: Review proposals and exact published visitor outcomes
steps: Select a bounded public-only review action without interrupting build continuations
Review and freeze proposals then collect independent structured votes
Select the ranked eligible proposal only after the current goal completes
Review checked task receipts independently before releasing dependencies
Observe the exact active immutable production response without credentials or outbound requests
Review each frozen criterion against actual public content and complete only with current independent evidence
expectedOutcomes: Visitor inputs and model output cannot select actor or target identity
Private operator revisions do not inherit public review authority
Unknown command delivery retains its original key while confirmed stale commands clear
Failed or inconclusive review keeps the goal unfinished with a public blocker
Paid activity requires existing activation, release and budget gates
Simulation and agent review never claim human or cloud verification
